title: Bad Circuit Boards

lines.en: Hello Grace. Thanks for taking my call.
lines.zh: 哈囉 Grace。謝謝你接我的電話。

lines.en: Of course, Daniel. I got your email about the circuit boards.
lines.zh: 當然，Daniel。我收到你寫的關於電路板的郵件了。

lines.en: Yes. We found a problem in the last order. About five percent of the boards don't work.
lines.zh: 是的。我們在上一張訂單發現問題。大約百分之五的板子不能用。

lines.en: I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what happens exactly?
lines.zh: 聽到這個我很抱歉。你可以告訴我到底發生什麼事嗎？

lines.en: Some boards don't turn on at all. Others turn on, but they stop after a few minutes.
lines.zh: 有些板子完全打不開。有些打得開，但幾分鐘後就停了。

lines.en: I see. Did you check the batch number?
lines.zh: 我了解了。你有確認批號嗎？

lines.en: Yes, it's B-2047. We received them on the second of November.
lines.zh: 有，是 B-2047。我們十一月二號收到的。

lines.en: Thank you. Let me write that down.
lines.zh: 謝謝你。讓我記下來。

lines.en: Our production line stopped for half a day because of this. That cost us a lot.
lines.zh: 我們的產線因此停了半天。這讓我們損失很多。

lines.en: I understand. That must be very frustrating. I apologize for the trouble.
lines.zh: 我明白。那一定非常令人沮喪。造成困擾，我向你道歉。

lines.en: I appreciate that. But what are you going to do about it?
lines.zh: 我很感謝。但你們打算怎麼處理？

lines.en: First, we'll look into the problem today. I'll ask my team to test the same batch in our lab.
lines.zh: 首先，我們今天就會調查這個問題。我會請團隊在實驗室測試同一批貨。

lines.en: How long will that take?
lines.zh: 那要多久？

lines.en: We should know more by tomorrow afternoon. We need to find the root cause.
lines.zh: 我們明天下午前應該會知道更多。我們得找出根本原因。

lines.en: Okay. What about the boards I already have?
lines.zh: 好。那我手上已經有的板子呢？

lines.en: Please send us ten of the bad boards. We'll make sure the courier picks them up tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: 請寄十片壞掉的板子給我們。我們會確保快遞明天早上去取件。

lines.en: Good. And I need working boards soon. My next delivery date is in ten days.
lines.zh: 好。而且我很快就需要能用的板子。我下一次交貨日在十天後。

lines.en: We'll send a replacement for every bad board at no cost.
lines.zh: 每一片壞掉的板子，我們都會免費寄替換品。

lines.en: That's fair. When can you ship them?
lines.zh: 這很合理。你們什麼時候能出貨？

lines.en: Within five working days. We'll make sure every board passes a full inspection before it ships.
lines.zh: 五個工作天內。我們會確保每片板子出貨前都通過完整檢驗。

lines.en: Five days is a bit long. Can you make it faster?
lines.zh: 五天有點久。可以再快一點嗎？

lines.en: Let me talk to the factory manager. I'll get back to you this afternoon.
lines.zh: 讓我跟廠長談談。我今天下午會再回覆你。

lines.en: Thank you. I'd also like a written report.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我也想要一份書面報告。

lines.en: Absolutely. It will include the cause and our plan to prevent it.
lines.zh: 沒問題。裡面會包含原因，以及我們的預防計畫。

lines.en: Good. This is the first problem we've had with your company.
lines.zh: 好。這是我們跟貴公司合作以來第一次出問題。

lines.en: I know, and we want to keep it that way. Your trust is very important to us.
lines.zh: 我知道，我們也希望維持這樣。你的信任對我們非常重要。

lines.en: I hope so. My manager is a little upset.
lines.zh: 希望如此。我的主管有點不高興。

lines.en: Would you like me to explain the situation to your manager?
lines.zh: 需要我向你的主管說明狀況嗎？

lines.en: Yes, please. That would be helpful.
lines.zh: 好的，麻煩你。那會很有幫助。

lines.en: I'll send her an email today and include my phone number.
lines.zh: 我今天會寄信給她，並附上我的電話。

lines.en: Great. What's the best way to contact you?
lines.zh: 太好了。用什麼方式聯絡你最好？

lines.en: You can call me anytime on my direct line, or send an email.
lines.zh: 你可以隨時打我的直撥電話，或寄電子郵件。

lines.en: Okay. I'll wait for your call this afternoon.
lines.zh: 好。我今天下午等你的電話。

lines.en: Yes. I'll call before four o'clock.
lines.zh: 好的。我四點前會打給你。

lines.en: Thanks, Grace. I feel a little better now.
lines.zh: 謝謝你，Grace。我現在感覺好一點了。

lines.en: I'm glad. Thank you for your patience, Daniel. Goodbye.
lines.zh: 我很高興。謝謝你的耐心，Daniel。再見。

quiz.q: What is the problem with the circuit boards?
options: Some of them do not work.
quiz.why: Daniel 說大約百分之五的板子不能用。

quiz.q: What will Grace's company send for free?
quiz.why: We'll send a replacement for every bad board at no cost.

quiz.q: When will Grace call Daniel back?
quiz.why: 她說會在今天四點前打給他。

words.ex1: First, we'll look into the problem today. I'll ask my team to test the same batch in our lab.
words.ex2: The QA team will look into the customer complaint today.
words.ex2zh: 品保團隊今天會調查這個客訴。

words.ex1: We should know more by tomorrow afternoon. We need to find the root cause.
words.ex2: We found the root cause of the defect in the soldering step.
words.ex2zh: 我們在焊接步驟找到了瑕疵的根本原因。

words.ex1: Let me talk to the factory manager. I'll get back to you this afternoon.
words.ex2: I'll get back to the customer after the lab test.
words.ex2zh: 實驗室測試完後，我會回覆客戶。

words.ex1: We'll send a replacement for every bad board at no cost.
words.ex2: The supplier agreed to send a replacement within a week.
words.ex2zh: 供應商同意一週內寄來替換品。

words.ex1: Within five working days. We'll make sure every board passes a full inspection before it ships.
words.ex2: Every shipment must pass an inspection before it leaves the factory.
words.ex2zh: 每批貨離開工廠前都必須通過檢驗。

speaking.patternZh: 我們會確保……（承諾一定會做到）

part2.why: 問 Where（哪裡），要回答地點。B 重複 quality 是陷阱，C 是時間。

part2.q: How many samples did you test?
part2.why: How many 問數量，答 About twenty。A 是地點，C 用 Yes 回答不通順。

part2.q: Would you like me to call the customer?
part2.why: Would you like me to 是提供協助，答 Yes, please do 最自然。A 重複 customer、B 重複 call 都是陷阱。
part2.zh: 需要我打電話給客戶嗎？

part2.why: 問 Why 要回答原因，Because 開頭。B 是 How 的答案，C 是地點。

part2.q: Should we repair the machine or buy a new one?
part2.why: 選擇問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。A、B 重複 machine 和 repair 是陷阱，C 是合理的回應。
part2.zh: 我們該修理機器還是買新的？

reorder.zh: 我們會確保每片板子出貨前都通過完整檢驗。
我們會確保快遞明天早上去取件。
我們會確保客戶星期五收到報告。

scene: 客戶 Daniel 打電話來抱怨電路板有瑕疵，品保人員 Grace 負責處理。
